title: QUADRIGA x-mappings Meta-Schema
description: Meta-schema for validating x-mappings vocabulary crosswalk annotations in QUADRIGA JSON Schema files. The x-mappings extension documents how schema elements (properties or types) map to standard vocabularies (Dublin Core, DCAT, DCMI Terms, LRMI, Schema.org, Modalia, HERMES) using SKOS relationship types.

$comment.description: Optional comment explaining mapping decisions or providing additional context about the x-mappings in this schema

relation.description: SKOS mapping relation type indicating the semantic relationship between the schema element and the target vocabulary term. See https://www.w3.org/TR/skos-reference/#mapping

mapping-entry.description: A mapping to a vocabulary term. The target can be a prefixed term (e.g., 'schema:name'), a full URI (e.g., 'https://github.com/tibonto/educor#EducationalResource'), a LOM data element path (e.g., '2.3.2 Life Cycle Contribute Entity'), or a DOI-qualified reference (e.g., '10.5281/zenodo.8010617 learningObjectives'). This allows ontologies to reuse definitions from other schemas.

$comment.description: Optional comment explaining this specific mapping, such as the source vocabulary attribute name or semantic differences

target.description: The target vocabulary term. Supported formats: a prefixed term using a namespace from @context (e.g., 'dc:title'), a full URI (e.g., 'https://github.com/tibonto/educor#EducationalResource'), a LOM data element path (e.g., '2.3.2 Life Cycle Contribute Entity' or '9 Classification'), or a DOI-qualified reference (e.g., '10.5281/zenodo.8010617 learningObjectives')
